en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a long, three-story institutional building with a tiled roof and many windows, behind a high plastered wall with trees along the inside. In the foreground there is a cultivated field and two people sitting near the wall. At the top center a caption in German reads "Polizeischule, Meißen." The scene has an early‑20th‑century European appearance.
